svg.title: Recall per attack: the kept checks in their claimed units (Track A N7 cells)
svg.desc: Per cell: label; recall k/n; dot = recall, whisker = its 95% CI; grey band = honest flag-rate 95% CI of the same sessions untampered. Synthetic tampering only.
svg.text: Recall per attack: the kept checks in their claimed units (Track A N7 cells)
Per cell: label; recall k/n; dot = recall, whisker = its 95% CI; grey band = honest flag-rate 95% CI of the same sessions untampered. Synthetic tampering only.
^ = a hit in an execution-path cell by a check without execution credit: an edit artifact, not in-scope power (DESIGN.md DA13).
Execution path (in scope): the agent controls the result content

svg.text: Track A probe cells (prereg_e.json n7_attack_battery, seed-0 plan, Wilson CIs as the probes computed them); not verifier measurements until parity (DESIGN.md DA15). The full table is recall_per_attack.html.
Recall cells: the replication split of each unit (E where the unit has E, else B); every split is in the source files. All tampering is synthetic.
